headline: Rabbit's new AI agent doesn't need an R1 to run
summary: Rabbit is rolling out a standalone AI agent, no R1 hardware required. The new OS3 "agentic operating system" runs in the cloud. It operates locally across Windows, Mac, and Linux devices.

headline: Saudi Arabia's new Exobot EVs make the Cybertruck look normal
summary: Saudi startup Ceer unveiled two hyper-angular, spaceship-like Exobot EVs. This marks a surprising entry for Saudi Arabia into EV manufacturing. The design makes even the Cybertruck appear conventional.

headline: Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 comes in an Extreme version too
summary: Qualcomm announced its new Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chipsets. An Extreme version joins the standard Gen 6 as a flagship offering. The Extreme model boasts enhanced AI processing, video capture, and gaming performance.

headline: Motorola's wild-looking Signature 27 runs Qualcomm's new Extreme chipset
summary: Motorola is the first to announce a phone featuring Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chip. The Signature 27 is expected to be Motorola's most advanced flagship in years. Full specs, price, and release date are still pending.

headline: Grand Theft Auto 6's Miami Takeover Begins as Rockstar Spends Nearly $1 Million on 'Welcome to Vice City' Signage
summary: Rockstar Games has reportedly spent $1 million on Grand Theft Auto 6 marketing. This includes a massive "Welcome to Vice City" sign installed in Miami. The move signals the start of GTA 6's major promotional push.

headline: Budget-Friendly Hilton Hotel Spark by Hilton Worth Knowing for 2026 Holiday Season
summary: Spark by Hilton is a new budget-friendly hotel brand backed by Hilton. It emphasizes reliable essentials, efficiency, and simplicity. This option is highlighted for the upcoming 2026 holiday season.

headline: The Best Physical Switch Game Deals in Nintendo's Customer Appreciation Sale
summary: Nintendo is holding a Customer Appreciation Sale with significant discounts. You can save 30% on a wide range of physical Switch games. The sale is set to end on September 26.

headline: Garfield - Escape from Monday Review
summary: The game "Garfield - Escape from Monday" received a review. It is described as a lackluster 3D platformer. Players are left wanting a more satisfying gaming experience.

headline: Burnham 'gets it' says Trump after first meeting
summary: Donald Trump and Andy Burnham met for the first time in New York. Trump stated he believes he can do business with Burnham. Trump also criticized the "terrible" Chagos deal during their encounter.

headline: Plot targeting Manchester's Jewish community disrupted, say police
summary: Counter-terror police have disrupted a plot targeting Manchester's Jewish community. Two men were arrested in Manchester on Sunday in connection with the plot. Investigations are ongoing into the alleged plan.

headline: Tim Westwood charged with two more sexual offences
summary: Tim Westwood has been charged with an additional two sexual offenses. The new allegations date back to 1991 and 2004. These charges follow previous accusations against the DJ.

headline: Piers Morgan urges Earl Spencer to pull Diana book
summary: Earl Spencer apologized to Piers Morgan for a factual error in his Princess Diana memoir. Morgan publicly called for Spencer to withdraw the book from shelves. Piers Morgan stated he is pursuing legal action against Earl Spencer.
